headline: Thanksgiving Memory
tagline: Flip, match & gobble up the fun

scenes.title: 9 Jumbo Preschool Cards
scenes.say: Start here with toddlers. Fewer pairs and big pictures make a perfect first game.

scenes.title: 12 Turkey Day Characters
tips: Name each card as you flip it
scenes.say: Name each character out loud as you flip, so little ones remember where it hides.

scenes.title: 16 Thanksgiving Day Scenes
tips: Tell a story about each scene
scenes.say: Tell a tiny story about each scene you turn over. It makes matching way more memorable.

scenes.title: 16 Harvest Animals & Finds
tips: Make the animal sound for a pair
scenes.say: Make the animal's sound whenever you find a pair. Kids giggle and remember better.

scenes.title: 16 Classic Harvest Icons
scenes.say: Save this one for older preschoolers. Similar fall colors mean they really have to look closely.

scenes.title: 20-Card Holiday Mix
scenes.say: For a longer round, split into teams and let the grown-ups join in while the turkey roasts.

scenes.title: 9 Jumbo Color-In Scenes
scenes.say: Let kids color both copies first, so their own artwork becomes the game.

tips.title: Before you print
items: Print each page twice to make pairs
Most sets come in color and B&W
tips.say: Print each page twice to make pairs, and grab the black and white version to save ink.

say.title: Free printable Thanksgiving memory games to keep little hands busy before dinner.
say.hook: Print twice, cut, and start flipping.
say.end: Download them all free at printamoo dot com.
